description: Two squadrons, one command, and the kind always comes first. Launched mining drones pick their own rocks - nearest ore or ice inside the ship's drone control range, recalling themselves when the hold fills or one of them takes fire - and launched salvage drones work the wrecks around the ship, nearest first or farthest first, going home when the cargo hold fills. /aud m is the mining menu (on/off, spread/focus, range, threshold, control, filter, list, status); /aud s is the salvage one (on/off, spread/focus, distance, range, threshold, list, status), and /aud on its own answers with one line per kind of drone without guessing which was meant. Any word may be cut down to the letters that still pick it out alone - /aud m f ore clear is /aud m filter ore clear, /aud s d farthest is /aud s distance farthest - and a letter two commands could take is answered with both. A wreck belongs to somebody, but stripping a hull is not what carries a flag in this game, taking the loot is, so every wreck in range is worked. The mining queue is a priority list printed as one numbered list per kind of rock, a mistyped rock name is answered with the one it meant, and /aud copy hands one character's whole setup to another, which is what a multibox fleet wants. Both kinds are classified by the game's own drone effects, so a hull that launches fifty drones under a third-party mod works them all. Every character drives it from ordinary chat (!aud), so no staff rights are needed, and what they choose is saved per character. Server-side only; no client change.
